title: `onFinish` does not get called in `streamText` when request stopped by the user from client side using `stop()` function
body:
### Description

Issue - on calling stop() from 'useChat()` React, on backend `streamText` does not call onFinish function.

Expected - on calling `stop()` from client side, `streamText` should trigger `onFinish` so that we can save in-complete message to the database and user can start querying new messages.

### AI SDK Version

- ai: 4.3.16
- @ai-sdk/react": "^1.2.11

linked_prs.title: feat (ai): add streamText onAbort callback
linked_prs.body:
## Background

When stream are aborted (e.g. via chat `stop()`), the `onFinish` callback is not invoked. However, a callback is needed to update the stored messages on the UI Message level for persistence.

## Summary

* End streaming when one stream is aborted in stitchable stream
* Gracefully add abort chunk instead of throwing error when a stream is aborted
* Add a `onAbort` callback to stream text

## Future Work

Support abort callback behavior for `toUIMessageStream` and `createUIMessageStream`.

## Related Issues

Fixes #6699 
Fixes #309

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it involves the agent's workflow and memory behaviors: the failure to call `onFinish` prevents proper message storage and workflow completion when the LLM stream is stopped, affecting agent-specific orchestration and memory handling.
